subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should marketplace listing and installation reject manifests above 16 MiB and symlinked manifest paths by default?
rationale: The implementation correctly removes the unbounded allocation path, but the threshold and regular-file-only policy intentionally narrow inputs accepted by existing local and cloned marketplaces.

options.title: Accept the bounded contract
options.body: Keep the 16 MiB cap and regular-file-only requirement across marketplace listing and installation.

options.title: Tune accepted inputs
options.body: Choose a different threshold or narrowly supported file layout while retaining the shared bounded, race-aware read.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded contract
recommendation.body: Keep the 16 MiB cap and regular-file-only requirement across marketplace listing and installation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the marketplace registry installation surface and recently maintained the affected loader contract.
